title: It used to be 4, now it’s 5
body:
Yah, I used to rate this 4.
But after using it for a few years, I now understand how essential this app has been for me, (I’m not using paid subscription btw) I’m training almost everyday, I keep motivating friends and familie. The achievement system truly works for me.

Definitely some stuff that can be improved, like when your watch is not connected, it should resume counting calories from the phone again at least. 
But this is just small stuff, everything else is wonderful.

title: Hi could We please get a better monthly and weekly summary?
body:
Hi could we please get a better monthly and weekly summary?
-Show how many K’s/miles total walked, also an option to sort between walking, running and other activities.
The diagram used in activity shows an average not what we’re after. Would enjoy seeing the actual distance for every day of distance.
-Hydration how hard would it be to get a simple water minder in the activity or health app
-improved UX sorting and filtering.
-The favorite feature is okay, but if we could remove things of our choosing and add other ones that are more important, that would be nice.
-Improved performance in activity, that instead of lots of different file types websites and converting to get your data from Strava into Nike Run Club and vice versa. That activity both sums the activity from the other aplications and update’s both strava and Nike Run Club automatically.

body:

I tillegg savner jeg funksjonen som Garmin Conect har hvor man kan legge inn styrkeøvelser med antall kilo og repetisjoner. Kan ikke være spesielt vanskelig å få til. Finnes en hel  del andre apper som gjør dette, men irriterende å måtte «switshe» mellom to apper gjennom en treningsøkt..
